    4. Initializes a graph as an ArrayList of ArrayLists of Edge objects, with N empty lists.
    5. Iterates M times to read three integers A, B, and C for each edge, adjusts A and B to be zero-indexed, merges A and B in the DSU, and adds edges to the graph with weights -C and C.

    8. Calls a depth-first search (dfs) function on the components with a BitSet and initial parameters.
    9. Initializes an integer array ans of size N, filled with -1.
    10. Iterates over each Component, and if the candidate set has exactly one element, calculates a minimum value and updates the ans array based on the component's add map.
    11. Outputs the ans array using the FastIO instance.
]
